description: Calculate return rate and operational returns costs for the same order cohort. Separate return freight, handling, reconditioning and actual product losses. Amounts exclude VAT. This is not store profit accounting: it does not automatically add sales refunds, lost margin or customer acquisition costs. With no returns, variable costs are zero and cost per return is undefined. Fixed costs still require a value. The tool does not determine contractual returns eligibility. Input fields: fulfilledOrders: Use the same group and observation window as the returns. returnedOrders: Count returned orders, not units or repeated requests. returnFreight: Average return freight borne by your business; 0 if none. processing: Receipt, inspection and administration. Avoid double counting. reconditioning: Include new packaging where applicable. Enter 0 if absent. productLoss: Only truly unrecoverable cost, averaged across all returns. Resellable stock is not a loss. fixedPeriodCosts: Total for the same scope. Blank does not mean zero.
name: calculate_return_costs
title: Ecommerce return rate and returns cost calculator
